ios.set.apps.mcpHint: Add it as a connector in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to let an AI assistant use your account. You choose what each app may do when you connect it.
ios.set.apps.empty: No apps connected yet. To connect one, add the MCP server URL above as a connector in Claude or ChatGPT.
ios.set.apps.revokeBody: {name} is disconnected right away and can't use your account until you connect it again.
ios.set.wallets.addBody: Connect an external Lightning wallet so your addresses and Cards can route payments through it.
ios.set.wallets.connectionHint: Paste or scan the NWC pairing QR from your wallet (Alby, Mutiny, Phoenix, …). It's stored encrypted and never displayed again.
ios.set.wallets.invalid: That isn't a valid nostr+walletconnect:// connection string.
ios.set.wallets.capabilitiesHint: Detected automatically from the wallet's NIP-47 get_info response. We use this to decide whether the wallet can both send and receive, or receive only.
ios.set.wallets.probeFailed: {error}. Wallet will be saved as receive-only.
ios.set.wallets.cannotReceive: This wallet cannot receive payments. It cannot be used for your primary Lightning Address.
ios.set.wallets.primaryHint: If you have a primary address, it will be linked to this wallet.
ios.set.wallets.lncurlWarning: LNCurl wallets cost **1 sat per hour** to stay alive — your **first hour is free**. If the balance runs out and hits **0 sats, the wallet is permanently destroyed**. Don't store large amounts.
ios.set.wallets.lncurlHint: Create an empty disposable wallet first, then fund it before use.
ios.set.wallets.nameTaken: A wallet with that name already exists. Choose another name.
ios.set.wallets.deleteBody: Addresses and cards using this wallet stop routing payments through it. This can't be undone.
ios.security.deleteHint: Removes your account, Lightning addresses, cards and remote wallets from this community, then signs you out.
ios.security.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account on {host}, including your Lightning addresses, cards and remote wallets. It can't be undone. Back up your secret key first if you want to keep your Nostr identity.
ios.security.deleteUnsupported: {host} can't delete accounts yet. Contact the community that runs it.
